## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] UI/UX polish
- [ ] Docs
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Security/privacy

## Privacy & Safety Checklist

- [ ] No secrets, tokens, keystores, local DBs, health exports, GPX files, or screenshots with personal data are committed.
- [ ] Raw health records are not sent to public/community endpoints.
- [ ] Raw route points remain private unless explicit user settings allow sharing.
- [ ] Missing sensor/data cases are handled without crashes or fabricated values.
- [ ] AI context is summarized/sanitized by default.

## Verification

- [ ] `flutter analyze`
- [ ] `flutter test`
- [ ] `flutter build apk --debug`
- [ ] `node --check koyeb_gateway/server.js` if gateway changed

## Screenshots / Notes

Add screenshots or manual QA notes when changing UI.
